subject: SIG request — Drive links, runbooks, screenshots, and checklist
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@novushealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novus Health Security <security@novushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request — Novus Health vendor onboarding

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Novus Security is running the SIG for new vendors and we need to collect the following artifacts from Redwood to complete our review:

- Owner-signed SIG questionnaire (we'll accept a completed spreadsheet)
- Operational runbooks covering certificate/key rotation and incident escalation
- Screenshots demonstrating KV cache encryption at rest and active KMS key policy (console view is fine)
- Network architecture diagram showing subnets and egress controls for the hosted API
- Copy of encryption key rotation policy and the associated change runbook

Can you share Drive links or attachments for the items above? Our target to finalize the assessment is next Wednesday 3/22; if you can get files over by EOD Monday 3/20 that would be ideal.

Also let us know if any items need redaction or an NDA — we can accommodate.

Thanks,
Lydia Chen
Sr. Information Security Analyst
Novus Health
[Novus Health Security (security@novushealth.com)]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@novushealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — Novus Health vendor onboarding

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything on your checklist. Quick notes: 

- We'll upload a completed SIG spreadsheet and an internal checklist that maps each SIG control to the artifact (helps your reviewers).
- For KMS/key rotation: would a screenshot of the scheduled rotation job + the rotation runbook PDF be sufficient, or do you need HSM audit logs as well?
- We'll share a redacted network diagram (no internal IPs) and an ops runbook for certificate rotation with timestamps and owners.

I'll coordinate delivery — copying Rishi (Security Ops) and Marissa (Customer Success) to confirm attachments and approvals to share. Expect a Drive folder link from us by Friday EOD.

Attached: sig_submission_checklist.xlsx (provisional mapping)
[Attachment: sig_submission_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 48 KB)]

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — Novus Health vendor onboarding

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 10:15 AM vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything on your checklist.

Hi team — tagging in the artifacts I'm preparing. Quick summary of what I'll upload to the shared folder:

- runbook_cert_rotation.pdf — operational runbook for cert/key rotation (includes playbook, escalation matrix, and example CLI commands).
- kv-cache-screenshot.png — screenshot showing encryption at rest flag and KMS key ID (redacted key ID partial).
- network_diagram_v2.png — redacted network diagram with subnets and NAT/Egress appliances.
- brief note on KMS: we use an external KMS provider (customer-managed option available); I can include the audit summary export if Novus requires it.

I recommend we avoid sending raw HSM logs over email; propose sharing via secure Drive link with view-only access and an expiration. Approve me to upload these 4 files to the folder and I will mark which items are redacted.

- Rishi Malhotra
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook_cert_rotation.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)]
[Attachment: kv-cache-screenshot.png (PNG, 420 KB)]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG evidence request — Drive folder + files (Novus Health)

Lydia — attaching the Drive folder and the files Rishi prepared. Everything below is shared view-only (link expiration 30 days) — let me know if you need different ACLs.

Drive folder (root): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bX_example_SIG_Evidence
Files included:
- runbook_cert_rotation.pdf — ops runbook for cert/key rotation
- kv-cache-screenshot.png — KV cache encryption at rest (sensitive fields redacted)
- network_diagram_v2.png — redacted architecture diagram
- sig_submission_checklist.xlsx — mapping from SIG controls to artifacts

Inline notes:
- We redacted full key IDs and internal hostnames before uploading.
- If you need the KMS audit export, we can share via a secure transfer; please confirm preferred mechanism.

[Links to files in folder above]

Attachments included in this thread for quick reference: runbook_cert_rotation.pdf, kv-cache-screenshot.png

Best,
Vanessa
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@novushealth.com>

Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — Drive folder + files (Novus Health)

Thanks Vanessa and Rishi — received the files and checklist, that looks good. A few follow-ups from our reviewer: 

1) Can you provide one additional screenshot showing an IAM role binding for the service account that runs the inference runtime (console view with role names visible)?
2) Please include the SLA excerpt that covers uptime and incident notification timelines (we only need the 1-page excerpt, not the full contract).

If you can send those two items by EOD Monday 3/20 we should be able to complete the SIG on time.

Thanks,
Lydia
